issue_body:
# /about — Persistent blank placeholder page

**Detected:** 2026-08-11T20:29:38.313Z 
**Prior audit:** 2026-08-11T09:15:25.007Z (same finding)

## Problem
The `/about` page renders only the stub text `"This is an about page"` over an animated teal particle canvas. There is no navigation bar, no real content (bio, experience, skills narrative, etc.), and no footer. This has persisted across multiple consecutive audits.

## Impact
- Visitors who navigate to `/about` from the portfolio nav see a blank, unfinished page — a poor first impression.
- The page is indexed (SEO 100) so it may surface in search results in this broken state.

## Steps to reproduce
1. Visit https://dliamkin.com/about on desktop or mobile.
2. Observe: only the particle animation background and the placeholder string are present.

## Suggested fix
Implement the About page content: add the shared site nav, a bio/intro section, experience or skills narrative, and the shared contact footer — matching the style of the rest of the site.
